key_insight: Training the PV forecaster to optimize battery scheduling, not just forecast accuracy, produced lower electricity costs even with worse prediction error.
engineering_relevance: For residential PV-battery systems, decision-focused learning can improve operational savings by aligning forecasting models with downstream control objectives.
method: LSTM PV forecasting model embedded in a battery scheduling optimization loop
Compared decision-focused training against a standard two-phase forecast-then-optimize approach
evidence_signal: Across 20 buildings over 14 months, the decision-focused method cut average electricity costs by 3.6% versus performance bounds, and warm-starting improved savings to about 8%.
watch_item: The approach improved cost outcomes but increased RMSE versus the decoupled baseline, so deployment should verify that lower forecast accuracy does not hurt system reliability or constraints.
paper_title: Decision-focused learning for optimal PV-Battery scheduling
